text:
mike: kicking off migration now — adding tenant_idx concurrently, expecting short locks on writes. will watch for long-running txs.

jess: heads-up: last time we saw a tenant with stuck open txs for 40m during backfill. prepared a session-eviction plan? :eyes:

mike: yes — plan is: let deploybot run the migration, wait 2x normal holdpoint (10m). if >5 sessions >2m blocked on that table -> run eviction script.

sarita: can we avoid hard kills unless necessary? prefer graceful terminate then force. I sketched two-step: SIGTERM via pg_cancel_backend then pg_terminate_backend after 30s.

mike: agreed. adding to runbook. also pinning app release to v2.14.1 so consumers don't pick up schema-dependent checks mid-cutover.

oliver: i'll update release notes and call out the pinned version and maintenance window (2026-03-14 02:00-04:00 UTC).

jess: deploybot: add holdpoint check and an escape-hatch flag so we can abort automated eviction if SRE is intervening.

deploybot: deploybot: holdpoint created at 1744447788. automated checks: table-lock-duration=600s, blocked_sessions_threshold=5. escape_hatch_flag=schema_eviction_disable.

mike: showing pg_stat_activity: 7 backends waiting, 3 active holders, some idle in tx. starting a 10m soft wait.

sarita: snippet for eviction (two-step) if we need it:
```sql
-- cancel first
SELECT pg_cancel_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE pid <> pg_backend_pid() AND state <> 'idle' AND wait_event_type='Lock' AND query LIKE '%ALTER TABLE tenant%';
-- after 30s, terminate
SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE pid <> pg_backend_pid() AND state <> 'idle' AND wait_event_type='Lock' AND query LIKE '%ALTER TABLE tenant%';
```

jess: good. add a telemetry event to track kills so we can roll back if kills > 10 across hosts.

mike: after 6m, two holders released, blocked down to 2. still under threshold. holdpoint extended 4m to let backfills finish.

deploybot: holdpoint update: extended to 1744447808. no eviction executed.

oliver: SRE approves extension, but add note to release notes: "may require rolling session eviction if blocked sessions persist; we will notify if eviction occurs."

mike: migration finished cleanly at 1744447803. no evictions performed. unpin in 1 hour and roll app forward.

jess: great. leaving the escape-hatch flag documented: schema_eviction_disable = true will prevent automated kills.

sarita: will add postmortem blameless note summarizing thresholds and telemetry. :white_check_mark:
